name: gpt2-xl
notes: 48 layers, d_model 1600, d_mlp 6400 (read from config at runtime).
Conv1D stores c_proj weight as [d_mlp, d_model], hence weight_transposed.
lm_head is transformer.wte - GPT-2 ties embedding and unembedding.
Edits must run on CPU or CUDA. MPS mishandles autograd through the in-place hook injection in compute_z (see DEV-001).
clamp_norm_factor 4 and v_lr 5e-1 validated on CPU; MEMIT's published clamp 0.75 breaks convergence in this implementation.
